theme_strategy.rationale: Quiet luxury beauty brands thrive on lit-from-within warmth, relying on cream, rose-gold, and champagne tones. Dark mode would contradict the soft, feminine aesthetic. Focus on a single, perfectly executed light theme.

rtl_support.guidelines: Crucial: Build mobile-first and use logical Tailwind CSS properties for spacing and alignment (e.g., `ms-4`, `pe-8`, `text-start`, `border-s-2`) instead of physical ones (`ml-4`, `pr-8`, `text-left`, `border-l-2`). This ensures automatic mirroring when the `dir` attribute is toggled on the `html` tag. Test with `dir="rtl"` in your root element.

typography.instructions: Import these fonts via Google Fonts in index.css. Use `dir="rtl"` or an active language state to dynamically swap Tailwind font-family utility classes between English and Arabic font stacks.

colors.instructions: Do not use stark black or stark white. Use `background_cream` for the main body and `plum_ink` for primary text. Use `rose_deep` for CTAs. Use `gold_accent` extremely sparingly (e.g., a 1px decorative line or a subtle active state indicator).

visual_enhancers.borders_and_radius: Use highly rounded corners: 16px to 26px (`rounded-2xl`, `rounded-3xl`) for cards and images. Use pill-shaped `rounded-full` for all buttons.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, gentle, dispersed shadows. Avoid harsh drop shadows. e.g. `shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(77,53,57,0.08)]`.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: No hard borders on cards. Rely on background color shifts (e.g., Cream to Sand) or very delicate borders using `dusty_rose` at 20% opacity. Use glassmorphism sparingly (`bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-xl`) only for sticky navigation to keep it airy.
visual_enhancers.motion: Implement subtle fade-ins and gentle upward slides on scroll using Framer Motion (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}`). Keep animations slow and elegant (e.g., `duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]`).

layouts.spacing: Extremely generous whitespace. Use `py-20` to `py-32` for section padding. Components should have ample breathing room.
layouts.grids: Use asymmetrical 'bento' or overlapping layouts for the marketing sections. For the skin quiz, use centered, distraction-free singular focal points.
layouts.hero: A split layout or an immersive image with a glassmorphism card over it. Text must be entirely legible—do not use generic dark overlays. A soft gradient or localized shadow behind text is preferred if it overlaps an image.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped. Primary: `bg-[#BE7D75] text-[#FAF3EF] hover:bg-[#a66a63] transition-colors`. Secondary: `bg-transparent border border-[#BE7D75] text-[#BE7D75]`.
components.cards: Soft background colors (`#F1E5DC` or `#F6E7E1`), heavily rounded (`rounded-3xl`), no border or ultra-faint border.
components.inputs: Customized Shadcn inputs. Use `rounded-full` or `rounded-2xl`, background `#FAF3EF` or `#ffffff/50`, soft border focus `ring-[#BE7D75]`.
components.quiz_cards: Tappable select cards should have a subtle hover lift (`-translate-y-1`) and active state indicated by `gold_accent` border or `rose_deep` background shift.

accessibility.guidelines: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Specifically, test `plum_ink` against `background_cream` (should pass easily), and `FAF3EF` text on `rose_deep` buttons. Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language toggler, quiz options).

libraries.icons: lucide-react (using lightweight elegant icons like Sparkles, ArrowRight, Check).
libraries.motion: framer-motion for page transitions, scroll reveals, and the quiz progress bar.
libraries.form: react-hook-form + zod for the waitlist, quiz, and booking flow.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use default Shadcn themes. Completely override colors in tailwind.config.js using the hex codes provided above. Use `dir="rtl"` for Arabic support and ensure all layouts use logical properties (`ps`, `me`, `text-start`). Do not use `transparent` backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns—use glassmorphism or solid `#FAF3EF`. Build a `.js` implementation, avoiding TypeScript-specific syntax since the workspace is not configured for it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize a 'quiet luxury' aesthetic: immense whitespace, flawless typography, and subtle micro-interactions. Avoid chaotic animations or 'tech startup' gradients. The feeling must be 'champagne and silk'. Always apply data-testid to interactive elements. Do not use AI emojis. Implement toast notifications using Sonner.
